articles.headline: FIFA's Gianni Infantino slams World Cup critics for 'spreading hate'
articles.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino has launched a scathing attack on critics of the 2026 World Cup, accusing them of being "consumed by hate" and saying they should "reflect, meditate, pray, or watch a football match."

articles.headline: The players who played no minutes at the World Cup -- who were the unlucky few?
articles.description: The World Cup was a time to remember for most, for a handful of players though, their time at the tournament was merely sitting in the best seats in the house.

articles.headline: Ranking every FIFA World Cup from 1930 to 2026
articles.description: Spain's romp to victory in 2026 capped a brilliant World Cup. But where did this summer rank in the all-time record?

articles.headline: President: Vozinha to sign for Colo Colo after stellar World Cup
articles.description: Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha has signed a contract with Colo Colo, the South American country's biggest soccer team, its president said.
